card.name: Preparing or reconstituting injectable solutions
card.fires_on: Words about making up a drug solution, such as prepared, preparation, constituted and Solution, in dosing and administration sections for injections or oral liquids. Often follows 'should be' or 'must be'.

modes.label: Prepared / constituted
modes.description: Verb form after 'be' saying who must prepare or mix the product.

modes.label: Preparation heading
modes.description: The noun preparation or the word Solution in reconstitution headings or aseptic-technique lines.
modes.example: Use aseptic technique during<< preparation>>. Reconstitute and dilute

modes.label: Constituted solution
modes.description: Partway through the word constituted in a storage heading.

card.plain: It marks the spot where the label talks about preparing or reconstituting a drug solution before giving it.
